label: Fick principle: aerobic supply is at most eta E Q (Ca - Cv)
statement_en: O2 delivered to tissue = cardiac output × (arterial − venous O2 content).

hypotheses.name: fick-principle#assumed-1
hypotheses.statement: conservation of O2 in the circulation; aerobic power only

scope.basis: a theorem about a model: it applies wherever the design supplies the quantities it uses and accepts the hypotheses in scope.assumed
assumed: conservation of O2 in the circulation; aerobic power only

non_vacuity_witness.statement: a positive power below the Fick supply with the measured teleost proxies

approval.basis: in force in lean/constraints.json / lean/laws.json before the registry existed; no per-law human review recorded by the registry

history.change: bootstrapped from lean/laws.json (status there: "stated-not-proved (the aerobic bound takes it as its named hypothesis fick_aerobic_supply)")

constraint_details.relation: η E_O2 Q Ca ≥ W v / (L/D)
constraint_details.canEliminate: a design claiming sustained powered flight its oxygen delivery cannot pay for
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C14, aerobic sustained flight.** A claim of sustained (aerobic) flight at power `P_req = W v/(L/D)` with
`η E Q Ca < P_req` is ruled out. -/
theorem aerobic_flight_rules_out {W v LD P η E Q Ca Cv : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hCv : 0 ≤ Cv)
    (hsus : P ≤ aerobicPower η E Q Ca Cv) (hflight : powerRequired W v LD ≤ P)
    (h : η * E * Q * Ca < powerRequired W v LD) : False := by
  have := sustained_flight_requires hη hE hQ hCv hsus hflight
  linarith

scope_note: Static mirror generated by dashboard/build-lean-api.mjs from lib/lean-source.mjs, the same loader the MCP tools (lean_laws_list, lean_law_get, lean_lawset_get) use. A law's status is a registry decision, not a truth value; "proved" means a Lean kernel proof about a model, never that the model describes an organism. Laws absent here are unchecked, not satisfied. Evaluation (lean_check) is not mirrored: the browser runs blueprint3d/browser-check.mjs locally via lean-client.js.
